title: Open restriction of a C¹ submanifold
statement: For all m, N ∈ ℕ and sets S, B ⊆ ℝ^N: if S is an m-dimensional C¹ submanifold in the sense of IsC1Submanifold m S (each point has a proper, injective C¹ chart with injective derivative onto W ∩ S for some open W) and B is open, then B ∩ S is an m-dimensional C¹ submanifold (IsC1Submanifold m (B ∩ S)).
lean_statement: ∀ (m N : ℕ) (S B : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N))), IsC1Submanifold m S → IsOpen B → IsC1Submanifold m (B ∩ S)
